title: Renewal pipeline dashgrid (ops sprint)
content:
Purpose: lightweight, action-oriented pipeline sheet for the fortnightly renewal sprint. Focus on committed ARR, near-term risk, clear owner actions. Use this as the single source for the sprint retro and QBR prep.

Column headers:
Account, Contract ID, ARR (USD), Renewal Date, Term (months), Renewal Probability (%), Health Score (0-100), Weighted ARR (formula), Next Step, Owner, Last Touch (YYYY-MM-DD), Risk Rationale, Upsell Opportunity, Action Due

Sample rows (canonical):
Helios Health, HHS-2024-01, 420000, 2026-12-12, 12, 85, 78, =C2*F2/100, Executive QBR scheduled, Priya Shah, 2026-10-28, Exec sponsor meeting went well; procurement timeline unclear, +Platform seats (80k), 2026-11-24
Arcadia Labs, ARC-8897, 175000, 2027-01-15, 12, 60, 52, =C3*F3/100, Prepare technical ROI deck, Marco Rossi, 2026-11-02, NPS dip after 7.2 deploy; support ticket backlog, +Advanced monitoring (20k), 2026-11-30
NexaPay, NPAY-3321, 98000, 2026-11-28, 24, 30, 40, =C4*F4/100, Legal follow-up on SOW redlines, Li Wei, 2026-11-10, Procurement on hold pending SOC2 evidence, None, 2026-11-18
VistaCRM, VIS-440, 260000, 2026-12-05, 12, 90, 88, =C5*F5/100, Ops-aligned renew + pilot expansion, Daniel Kim, 2026-11-15, Health high; want a guaranteed latency SLA for demo, +Pilot seats (45k), 2026-11-22
Lumen Retail, LUM-009, 52000, 2026-12-20, 12, 45, 35, =C6*F6/100, Risk call with CSM, Priya Shah, 2026-10-21, Price-sensitive; competing platform PoC, +None, 2026-11-25
Orion Analytics, ORN-720, 125000, 2026-12-02, 12, 70, 66, =C7*F7/100, Confirm usage trends & show optimization plan, Marco Rossi, 2026-11-11, Usage down 18% month-over-month, potential stickiness issue, +Inference optimization (15k), 2026-11-20
Atlas Manufacturing, ATL-201, 300000, 2027-02-10, 12, 50, 49, =C8*F8/100, Finance approval waiting, Daniel Kim, 2026-11-03, Legal requested indemnity language changes, +None, 2026-12-01
Sora Media, SOR-115, 64000, 2026-11-30, 12, 95, 92, =C9*F9/100, Auto-renew expected; confirm billing, Li Wei, 2026-11-08, Recently expanded usage; champion in Prod, +Analytics seats (10k), 2026-11-16

Notes on fields and formulas:
- Weighted ARR = ARR * (Probability/100). Use sheet formula cell-level as above. Pivot on Weighted ARR to get expected ARR by month.
- Health Score = composite of NPS, usage % of baseline, recent support severity weighted. (Quick calc: 40% usage, 30% NPS, 30% support).
- Risk Rationale should be 2–3 bullets max; when >2 risk flags present, mark risk level in red and add a risk tag.

Views / Filters to add:
- Next 60 days: Renewal Date within today+60.
- High priority: Weighted ARR > 50k and Probability < 60% -> escalate to CS lead for attack plan.
- Legal blockers: text filter containing "Legal" or "SOW" or "procurement".

Sprint playbook (operational):
- Monday: Triage meeting (30m) to assign owners and confirm action due dates.
- Wednesday: Draft outreach templates updated (owner: Daniel).
- Friday: Checkpoints and escalation for low-probability high-dollar accounts.
- Deliverables: 1-page account play sent to AE and CSM; update Jira ticket (linked_artifacts) with outcome.

Outstanding questions / TODOs:
- Add a column for "Committed by AE" vs "CS Expectation" to capture alignment — open item for next sprint.
- Confirm whether renewals under 50k should follow templated outreach or SDR touch model. (Owner: Priya)
- Integrate contract end-of-term alerts with Console billing hooks — referenced in CONFLUENCE-1234.

Color legend (for sheet conditional formatting):
- Red: Probability < 40% OR Health Score < 50.
- Yellow: 40% <= Probability < 70% OR Health Score 50-69.
- Green: Probability >= 70% AND Health Score >= 70.

Metrics to report to QBR (pull from this sheet):
- Total ARR at risk (sum of ARR where Probability < 70%).
- Expected ARR (sum of Weighted ARR for next 90 days).
- Top 5 at-risk accounts by Weighted ARR.

Change log (quick):
- 2026-11-05: Created initial draft. (Daniel)
- 2026-11-10: Added sample rows + risk rationale template. (Priya)
- 2026-11-17: Added sprint playbook and filters, moved to in_review. (Marco)

Contact: Daniel Kim (daniel.k@redwood.com) for questions or handoff notes.

Quick export tips:
- Export CSV for Jira bulk update (map Contract ID -> issue).
- Use the pivot view for monthly expected ARR by renewal month.

End of sheet.
